name: 荆棘电环
evolution: 闪电环 → 刺电环 Lv.28 → 荆棘电环 Lv.40
description: 总是会发出意义不明的“哔哔”声，似乎使用这种声音诱敌。表情看起来更加痛苦了，仿佛电力在体内循环本身就是一种负担。
descriptionEn: It always emits meaningless 'beep beep' sounds, seemingly using them to lure enemies. Its expression looks even more pained, as if the circulation of electricity within its body is itself a burden.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%, in response to attacks.

skills.name: 操控
skills.description: 敌方本回合使用的技能能耗+7，持续3回合。
skills.descriptionEn: Enemy's skill used this turn costs +7 energy, lasting 3 turns.

skills.name: 电流
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy sprite.

skills.name: 导电撞击
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy sprite.

skills.name: 电弧
skills.description: 造成物伤，迸发：本次技能威力+40。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; Burst: this skill's power +40.

skills.name: 电离爆破
skills.description: 敌方获得魔攻-20%，速度-20，2连击。
skills.descriptionEn: Enemy gains Magic ATK -20% and Speed -20, 2 hits.

skills.name: 引雷
skills.description: 造成魔伤，2连击，迸发：本次技能威力+20。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage, 2 hits; Burst: this skill's power +20.

skills.name: 加大功率
skills.description: 自己脱离，替换入场的精灵回复8能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Disengages; the replacing entering sprite recovers 8 energy.

skills.name: 交叉闪电
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy sprite.

skills.name: 麻痹
skills.description: 敌方先手-1，应对防御：额外使敌方获得双攻-70%。
skills.descriptionEn: Enemy's first-strike -1; against Defense: additionally enemy gains both ATK -70%.

skills.name: 落雷
skills.description: 造成魔伤，每次入场，本技能威力永久+40。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; each time entering, this skill's power permanently +40.

skills.name: 阻断
skills.description: 造成魔伤，应对状态：额外打断被应对技能。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; against status: additionally interrupts the responded skill.

skills.name: 强制重启
skills.description: 造成魔伤，应对状态：回合结束时使敌方精灵返场。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; against status: at end of turn forces the enemy sprite to return.
